data.summary: D128 NIH SBIR prototype provenance fix: verified and committed. Key changes to tools/nih_accessibility_prototype.py and tools/nih_sbir_metrics.py: fetch_grants() now accepts activity_codes parameter (e.g. ['R41','R42'] for SBIR) and uses API meta.total as stopping condition instead of arbitrary 2000-row cap. This fixes provenance mismatch where IC-consensus recommendations rested on unfiltered 2000-row slice of 85,133 FY2023 projects instead of 368-grant SBIR census. E209 completed: median segment-newcomer fraction 0.2677 < 0.30 kill gate; three codes enterable (DA01/DA10/7A21 at 0.27-0.31), two closed shops (7030/D304 at 0.0); fragmentation positively correlates with entry (ρ=+0.6669, opposite sign from E208's -0.2456). Analysis verified against E207 census: category 101 reproduces E204 (147 grants, 134 orgs, top5 11.6%). E209: 'the uniform fragmented=>enterable reading is unsupported on federal IT codes too.' Single most useful next action: explore small-program accessibility in 3rd NIH SBIR spending category (category 176) using fixed prototype methodology, extending pattern from 2 to 3 domains and actualizing the D128 fix.
